description:
Daily report to find ISBN or OCLC matches between new orders created on a specific date and all records in FOLIO to evaluate matches for duplication. The report defaults pre-filling the current date for the end date (the date the report is run) and a start date of the day before to find orders created on the start date. The report includes records created on the start date up to but not including the end date.

The report returns the following fields for new orders: PO number, Instance HRID, vendor code, date PO was created, workflow status, fund code, list price, order format, rush status, title from the POL, publication date from the POL, publisher from the POL, identifier type, raw identifier (includes any related text), identifier (just the ISBN or OCLC number)

The report returns the following fields for the matched records: Instance HRID, title, instance discovery suppressed status, instance status,  instance statistical code, contributors, dates of publication, edition, holdings types, holdings locations.
instructions: Confirm default dates are for previous and current date and run using defaults when looking for new orders created the previous day. You will need to adjust the dates when running the report on Monday for the previous Friday, dates after holidays, or for other date ranges.
